widgets_values: An editorial fashion photograph set on a rain-washed elevated tram platform in a retro-futurist city at blue hour. An adult East Asian woman with a sleek silver-white bob, cool gray eyes, and a composed, slightly defiant expression stands at the foreground, her full figure visible from head to boots. She wears a tailored midnight-blue coat with architectural shoulders over an ivory silk blouse, a long oxblood pleated skirt, and polished dark boots. One hand holds a folded clear umbrella by its curved handle; the other rests naturally at her side, with anatomically believable fingers. Behind her, a vermilion tram is arriving, its warm windows casting long reflections across glossy wet tiles. Elevated walkways and softly illuminated apartment facades recede into layered atmospheric perspective. The image feels like a frame from an expensive alternate-history fashion film: realistic pores and separate hair strands, convincing seams and fabric tension, restrained halation on practical lights, deep cobalt shadows, warm copper highlights, and elegant negative space around the model. A low three-quarter camera angle emphasizes her presence without distorting proportions. Keep the frame visually refined and uncluttered, with a clear subject silhouette and no decorative text.
